headline: Newark is running behind; the other hubs are running normally.

items.text: Of the seven United hubs reporting so far today, Newark (EWR) is lowest, with 67% of its 250 departures leaving within 30 minutes of schedule.
The other hubs are running normally.
No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any United hub, and weather is not affecting operations at any of the 9 United hubs with a current report.
